title: DOW-KE: Anchor-Free Multi-Layer Knowledge Editing via Direct End-to-End Weight Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.16932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-layer locate-then-edit methods for knowledge editing first optimize target residual-stream activations (anchors) at selected layers, then realize them layer by layer as weight updates. This pipeline optimizes an intermediate representation but deploys multi-layer weight updates whose joint effect through the true forward pass is never itself optimized: regardless of how anchors are set or propagated, each update comes from a local solve, so propagation-induced attenuation and distortion go uncorrected, leaving a closure gap between anchor targets and realized edits. We propose DOW-KE, an anchor-free method built on a single principle: what is optimized must be exactly what is deployed. DOW-KE backpropagates the final editing objective through the complete model, jointly optimizing the updates of all edited layers so cross-layer propagation and coupling enter every gradient step. The same principle dictates where preservation reside

translated_title: DOW-KE：基于直接端到端权重优化的无锚点多层知识编辑
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16932v1 公告类型：新 摘要：用于知识编辑的多层定位-然后-编辑方法首先在选定层优化目标残差流激活（锚点），然后逐层将其实现为权重更新。该流程优化了中间表示，但部署的多层权重更新通过真实前向传播的联合效果从未被自身优化：无论锚点如何设置或传播，每个更新都来自局部求解，因此传播引起的衰减和失真未被校正，导致锚点目标与实际编辑之间存在闭合差距。我们提出DOW-KE，一种基于单一原则的无锚点方法：所优化的必须正是所部署的。DOW-KE通过完整模型反向传播最终编辑目标，联合优化所有编辑层的更新，使跨层传播和耦合进入每个梯度步骤。同一原则也决定了保留的位置所在。
tldr: DOW-KE通过直接端到端优化所有编辑层的权重更新，消除了锚点目标与实际编辑之间的闭合差距，实现了更准确的多层知识编辑。
en_tdlr: DOW-KE eliminates the closure gap between anchor targets and realized edits by directly optimizing weight updates across all edited layers end-to-end, enabling more accurate multi-layer knowledge editing.
